subject: mathematics_2a
question_text: Find the variance and standard deviation of the following frequency distribution: xᵢ = 4, 8, 11, 17, 20, 24, 32; fᵢ = 3, 5, 9, 5, 4, 3, 1.

mark_split.label: Find N, Σfᵢxᵢ and the mean
Form the (xᵢ − x̄)² and fᵢ(xᵢ − x̄)² columns and their sum

recall_prompt: Say how you would find the variance and standard deviation of a discrete frequency table directly — how you get the mean, what you square, and what you divide.
insider_note: The mean x̄ = 14 must be found before any deviation can be squared, and the question asks for BOTH numbers: σ² = 45.8 and then its square root σ = 6.77 — the root is the last mark.

steps.label: N, Σfᵢxᵢ and the mean
steps.margin_note: First two marks. The mean is needed BEFORE any deviation can be written, so it comes first. Columns: xᵢ, fᵢ, product fᵢxᵢ. N = 30 and Σfᵢxᵢ = 420 give x̄ = 14, a whole number — which is why this question uses the direct formula and not step deviation.

recall.must_convey: That N = 30, the products fᵢxᵢ add to 420, and the mean is 420/30 = 14.
accept: N is thirty, sigma f i x i is four hundred twenty, so the mean is fourteen
multiply each x i by its frequency, add to get four twenty, divide by thirty to get fourteen
the mean is sigma f i x i by N which is four twenty by thirty equals fourteen
f i x i column add cheste four twenty, thirty tho divide cheste mean fourteen
mean comes to fourteen

steps.why: Variance measures spread around the mean, so the mean must exist before a single deviation can be written. With a frequency table the mean is the weighted total Σfᵢxᵢ over N.
common_mistakes: Averaging the seven xᵢ values (116/7) and ignoring the frequencies.
Dividing Σfᵢxᵢ by 7 instead of by N = 30.

steps.label: Squared deviations
steps.margin_note: Next two marks. Columns: xᵢ, fᵢ, deviation xᵢ − 14 (signed), its square, and fᵢ times the square. Signs disappear on squaring; 300 appears twice because −10 and 10 square to the same 100. The sum is 1374.

lines.text: xᵢ     fᵢ     xᵢ − x̄     (xᵢ − x̄)²     fᵢ(xᵢ − x̄)²

recall.must_convey: That each value's deviation from 14 is squared, multiplied by its frequency, and the products add to 1374.
accept: subtract fourteen from each x i, square it, multiply by f i and add to get one thousand three hundred seventy four
the squared deviations are hundred thirty six nine nine thirty six hundred three twenty four and the weighted sum is thirteen seventy four
square each deviation from the mean, weight by frequency, total one three seven four
prathi x i nunchi fourteen teesi square chesi f i tho multiply cheste sum thirteen seventy four
sigma f i into x i minus x bar squared is one thousand three hundred and seventy four
heard_as: one thousand three hundred and seventy four

steps.why: Variance averages SQUARED distances from the mean. Squaring, unlike the absolute value, keeps the algebra simple, and it weights a large deviation (18 → 324) far more than a small one (3 → 9).
common_mistakes: Squaring fᵢ(xᵢ − x̄) instead of multiplying fᵢ by (xᵢ − x̄)².
Using |xᵢ − x̄| (mean deviation) instead of (xᵢ − x̄)².

steps.label: Variance
steps.margin_note: Next two marks. Divide the weighted sum by N = 30: 1374/30 = 45.8 exactly.

recall.must_convey: That the variance is Σfᵢ(xᵢ − x̄)² divided by N: 1374/30 = 45.8.
accept: variance is thirteen seventy four by thirty which is forty five point eight
divide the weighted sum of squares by N thirty to get forty five point eight
sigma squared equals one by N into sigma f i x i minus x bar squared equals forty five point eight
thirteen seventy four ni thirty tho divide cheste forty five point eight
the variance is forty five point eight

steps.why: Variance is the mean of the squared deviations, so the final division is by N = 30, the total number of observations counted with frequency.
common_mistakes: Dividing by 7 (the number of rows) instead of 30.
Dividing by N − 1 = 29 — the sample formula is not the one this syllabus uses.
Stopping at 1374 and calling it the variance.

steps.label: Standard deviation
steps.margin_note: Last mark. √45.8 = 6.767…, written 6.77 (6.77² = 45.83). Same unit as the data.

recall.must_convey: That the standard deviation is the square root of the variance: σ = √45.8 = 6.77.
accept: standard deviation is root forty five point eight which is six point seven seven
take the square root of the variance to get six point seven seven
sigma equals root of forty five point eight equals six point seven seven
variance ki square root theesthe six point seven seven
S D is six point seven seven

steps.why: Variance is in squared units. The square root brings the spread back to the unit of xᵢ, so σ = 6.77 can be read against the values 4 to 32 directly.
common_mistakes: Reporting only the variance when the question asks for both.
√45.8 taken as 6.8 — the book's two-decimal convention gives 6.77.
Writing σ = 45.8 and σ² = 6.77 the wrong way round.
